text: Coffee with Kiara this morning. Her son Tiago starts reception on 3rd of September and she's already labelling every single jumper. She's off dairy again, oat milk only. Remind me to text her that morning to see how drop-off went.
Femi rang. Second round interview at the council on Thursday at 2pm, panel of four. He sounded really nervous, kept saying he'll blank on the case study. Need to send him good luck Wednesday night.

spans.text: Second round interview at the council

text: Bumped into Delroy and his wife at the market. Their eldest, Imogen, graduates from Leeds on 14 July. Delroy's planning a big barbecue after. He's gone vegan since the spring, which nobody saw coming.
Aneesh doesn't drink anymore, says alcohol-free Guinness is the find of the year. Coeliac too, so no pub pies for him.

Lunch with Mandla. He got the job at the architecture firm!! Starts 1 Nov, 9am sharp, in the Shoreditch office. His partner Reza is so relieved, the last three months were rough on both of them. Reza's cooking a celebration dinner on Saturday at 7, says no meat as Mandla's trying to go pescatarian. Must send a congrats card.

Emeka's daughter has her GCSE maths paper on 12/06 at half 9. He says she's fine about it but he's the one not sleeping. Her brother Abdi did the same exams two years ago and sailed through, which isn't helping. Their mum is making jollof for the whole street once it's over.
Florin's application for the Sheffield lecturer post went in last Friday. He hears back by the 28th. Trying not to think about it, he says.

spans.text: application for the Sheffield lecturer post

text: Pick up the cake for Saturday at 10am, then car wash.

Spoke to Carlos on the phone. The interview at the logistics place got cancelled, they've frozen hiring. He's applying to the hospital instead, deadline 20 October at midnight. Ask him on Monday how the application's going.

Meera and Arjun took the twins for their first day at nursery today. Meera cried in the car park, Arjun pretended he didn't. Twins apparently loved it. Their dog Biscuit sulked all afternoon without them.
Jorge's birthday is 9th of March. Loves really hot food, the hotter the better, and mezcal. He's been hinting about wanting a proper molcajete.

spans.text: hinting about wanting a proper molcajete

text: Simone is vegetarian but eats fish. Can't stand coriander. Remember both for the dinner on the 2nd at 7.
Michael rang this evening. His interview at the bank yesterday at 4 went well he thinks, they said they'd decide by Friday. Remind me to ask Michael on Friday afternoon if he's heard anything.
Liam passed his driving test this morning, third go! His mum's taking him out for a curry tonight to celebrate. Text him congrats.

Bogdan's graduation was supposed to be 5 December but the uni moved it to 16 January at 11am. His parents are flying in from Bucharest for it and he has no idea where to put them, he's quite stressed about the whole thing. His girlfriend Saskia has offered her sofa bed but he thinks that's a bit much.
Thomas mentioned his little girl Aditi starts primary on 4/09. He's taking the morning off. His wife's back at work that week so he's doing every school run.

Long chat with Chen after the team meeting. She's been turned down for the senior role twice now and is thinking of leaving altogether. She has a video interview with a fintech startup on 22 Oct at 3pm and she's anxious about the technical part, hasn't coded under pressure in years. Her husband Henrik thinks she should just go for it. I should check in with her next week, maybe take her for lunch.

spans.text: turned down for the senior role
video interview with a fintech startup

text: Cem is off gluten for a month, doctor's orders, while he waits on a coeliac test on the 30th.

Aidan and Saskia's son Sam gets his A-level results on 13 August. Saskia says he's pretending not to care but checks UCAS every hour. They're doing a family dinner that evening either way. Aidan's taking the day off and will drive Sam in for 8am to collect the envelope. Sam's first choice is Manchester for engineering.

spans.text: first choice is Manchester for engineering

text: Georgia hates mushrooms. Like, properly hates them. Also allergic to kiwi. Prosecco is her drink.
Tiago lost his first tooth, according to Kiara. He now wants to be a dentist when he grows up.

Sean got the redundancy news this morning. Meeting with HR on Wednesday at 10am. He's being brave about it but his wife told me he's not sleeping. Their kids don't know yet. He mentioned he'd been quietly applying elsewhere since summer, so not a total shock. Ring him Thursday.
Imogen is thinking of applying for the masters at Edinburgh, applications close 31st of January. Not sure she can afford it.

spans.text: applying for the masters at Edinburgh

text: Manon and her partner are doing dry January, then it's Manon's birthday on 1st of Feb so it all goes out the window. She likes natural wine, the cloudy orange stuff.
Need to finish my CV before Friday at noon. Applying for the Bristol role myself.
Kiara Shah, Kiki to everyone at work, called. Can't do the picnic on Sunday now, her daughter has a swimming gala at 2.

Femi update: he didn't get the council job, they went with an internal candidate. He's ok, a bit flat. Already has another interview lined up next Tuesday morning at the uni. Remind me to message him good luck Monday night.
Delroy's mum turns 80 on 18 May. Family lunch at 1, he's doing jerk chicken. She can't handle spicy anymore though so there'll be a separate mild pot just for her.
Aneesh's son finished his last exam today at 11, history. They're celebrating with pizza. Aneesh was a wreck all week.
Mandla saw Dr Kaur, his allergy consultant, and he can start reintroducing nuts slowly. He's thrilled. First peanut butter in ten years is planned for Saturday breakfast.

spans.text: First peanut butter in ten years

text: Reza starts his new role at the NHS trust on the 3rd at 8am. First day in a job he actually wanted. Send him a message Sunday evening.

spans.text: new role at the NHS trust

text: Emeka let slip his wife's expecting, due around the 20th of March. They're not telling work yet. She's off coffee and can't stand the smell of garlic at the moment.

spans.text: can't stand the smell of garlic

text: Abdi's passing out parade at the police academy is Friday at 3pm. His whole family are going, his little sister made a banner. I'm going to try to get there for the photos after.

spans.text: passing out parade at the police academy

text: Florin's wedding is off. He and Simone split up last month. He's moving back to Cluj on 1 December, already booked the van. Should take him for a drink before he goes.
Carlos says his kids are both vegetarian now, after a school trip to a farm. He's very much not.

Meera thinks her interview went great, the panel said a decision by the end of next week. She wants to celebrate either way, drinks at hers on the 25th from 7. Bring something alcohol-free for Arjun, he's on antibiotics.

spans.text: by the end of next week

text: Jorge Lopez, JL at work, passed his accountancy finals! Results came this morning at 8. Office cake at 4pm, he hates chocolate so get lemon.
Oat milk, eggs, gluten free pasta, lemons, bin bags.

spans.text: Oat milk, eggs, gluten free pasta, lemons, bin bags

text: Simone mentioned her mum's hip op is on 7th of November at 7.30am. Simone's taking the week off to look after her. Must ask her how it went that afternoon.
Michael and his husband are adopting, the panel meeting is 12 Nov at 10. Huge deal, they've waited two years. He says they're both terrified. Remind me to text them good luck the night before.
Liam's little brother starts secondary on Monday. Liam's walking him in and the poor kid is mortified.
Bogdan only drinks black coffee, no sugar, and never after 2pm. G and T in the evenings, Hendrick's if possible.

Saw Thomas at the school gates. His son's got a place at the grammar, letter came Saturday. Thomas is chuffed, his wife less so because of the commute. Their daughter starts sixth form at the same time, so two uniforms to buy in one go. Get the lad a card.

Manon has her PhD viva on 15/05 at 10.30. She is properly terrified, keeps saying the external examiner hates her methods. Her flatmate Georgia is making her practise answers every evening. I should send her something encouraging the day before, maybe flowers.
Chen called, the startup offered her the job! Starts 6 January. She's handing in her notice tomorrow morning. Henrik's taking her out for sushi Friday night.
Henrik Petrov is allergic to shellfish, carries an EpiPen. So sushi is a slightly odd choice but he says he's fine with the veggie rolls.
Cem's son had his first day of school today. Cem sent a photo of him in a blazer three sizes too big. Ask Cem at football how the first week went.

spans.text: Ask Cem at football how the first week went

text: Aidan's cat Pickle had her op this morning at 9, teeth out. She's home now and very groggy. Aidan's been fretting all day.
Georgia's interview at the gallery is the 14th at 11am. It's her dream job. She's nervous about the presentation part, ten minutes on a piece of her choice. Wish her luck the morning of.
Kiara's throwing Tiago a little party for passing his grade 3 piano, Sunday at 4. No nuts in anything, his cousin's allergic.
Sean Williams rang back. HR meeting got moved to the 27th. He's applying for jobs in the meantime, two applications in already. Don't forget to send him the contact at Yilmaz Logistics.

spans.text: send him the contact at Yilmaz Logistics

text: Imogen's mum is a retired chef and won't let anyone else near the kitchen at Christmas. Imogen herself survives on toast.

spans.text: won't let anyone else near the kitchen

text: Manon passed!! Viva done, minor corrections only. Doctor Manon from now on. Party at the Crown, Saturday 2 November, 8pm.

Long one with Kiara and Femi at the pub. Femi's sister Aditi graduated from medical school on 20th June and starts as a junior doctor the first Wednesday in August, nights straight away. Femi is so proud he made us look at forty photos. Kiara's going back to work in January now Tiago's settled, she's got an interview at the library on 8 Nov at half 1. She's nervous, it's been five years. Remind me to wish her luck the day before and to ask Femi to pass my congrats on to Aditi.

spans.text: ask Femi to pass my congrats on to Aditi

text: Dentist Tuesday 3pm, then dry cleaning. Gym tomorrow at 6am, no excuses.
Reza won't eat pork, and he's mostly cut out sugar since the diabetes diagnosis. Diet coke still allowed apparently.
Abdi's driving theory test was cancelled because of the strike. Rebooked for 10/11 at 9.15. He's more annoyed than anything.

Delroy says Imogen didn't get the grad scheme at the big accounting firm, but she's had two more interviews since and one's a second round on Monday. Delroy's more stressed than she is. Imogen's flatmate Georgia already works there and put a word in. Ask him Tuesday what happened.

spans.text: grad scheme at the big accounting firm

text: Florin texted. Arrived in Cluj, flat's tiny but the view's great. His mum's feeding him nonstop and he's already put on half a stone.

Quick one after parents' evening. Meera says the year 6 SATs are the week of 12 May and the kids start mocks tomorrow morning. Her daughter gets wobbly about tests, so they're doing extra reading at bedtime. Need to give back the maths book I borrowed from her by Thursday.

spans.text: give back the maths book I borrowed from her
